deckIntent: High-impact editorial trends report on climate tech's explosive 2025 moment — massive display typography, cinematic full-bleed photography of renewable installations and climate solutions, aggressive accent color rotation between forest green, electric blue, and solar orange. Magazine-quality presentation where each card breathes with one dominant insight about the climate tech revolution.

cards.cardInstructions: Title card with massive display text 'Climate tech gets *serious* in 2025' on solid forest green background. No image. The accent italic word 'serious' signals the shift from experimental to mainstream. Pure typography impact.

Section divider for infrastructure chapter. White background, massive display 'The race for *scale* infrastructure' with forest green accent on 'scale'. Below: solidBoxes smart layout with 4 structured items covering grid modernization, battery storage, green hydrogen networks, and carbon capture systems. No image.

Article opener with full-bleed cinematic photo of massive solar farm installation behind display text 'Grid transformation accelerates beyond recognition'. Forest green accent on 'accelerates'. 8-word declarative statement about infrastructure velocity.

Content card with H2 headline 'Battery storage costs drop 89% in three years'. White background, image right showing grid-scale battery facility. Left column: short paragraphs on cost curves, deployment speed, grid stability impact. Highlight '89%' and 'three years' in forest green.

Quote card with full-bleed atmospheric photo of wind turbines at sunset behind large bold quote: 'The infrastructure buildout happening now will define energy for the next 50 years.' Attribution: Sarah Chen, Infrastructure Director, Breakthrough Energy. 45 words total.

Analytical spread with 2-column structure. Headers: 'Infrastructure gaps' / 'Investment priorities'. Image top-half showing smart grid control room. Below: two columns analyzing transmission bottlenecks vs funding allocation. Forest green column headers.

Section divider for funding chapter. White background, massive display 'Capital flows reach *breakthrough* velocity' with electric blue accent on 'breakthrough'. Below: solidBoxes smart layout with 4 items covering venture scale-up, corporate partnerships, government backing, and retail investor access.

Article opener with full-bleed photo of modern clean energy trading floor behind display text 'Funding models evolve for climate urgency'. Electric blue accent on 'evolve'. Shows the sophistication of climate finance.

Content card with H2 headline 'Climate VC funding hits $48B despite economic headwinds'. White background, image right showing diverse startup founders in lab setting. Left: analysis of funding resilience, sector preferences, geographic distribution. Highlight '$48B' and 'headwinds' in electric blue.

Quote card with full-bleed photo of modern green building facade behind bold quote: 'Climate tech is no longer a bet on the future — it's essential infrastructure for today's economy.' Attribution: Marcus Rodriguez, Partner, Greentech Capital. 50 words total.

Section divider for innovation chapter. White background, massive display 'Innovation cycles compress to *months* not years' with solar orange accent on 'months'. Below: solidBoxes smart layout with 4 items covering AI optimization, materials science, deployment automation, and regulatory fast-tracking.

Article opener with full-bleed cinematic photo of advanced materials lab with researchers behind display text 'Breakthrough materials reshape energy storage'. Solar orange accent on 'breakthrough'. Shows the cutting-edge science driving the revolution.

Content card with H2 headline 'AI cuts renewable energy waste by 40%'. White background, image right showing AI control center monitoring renewable assets. Left: short paragraphs on predictive optimization, grid balancing, maintenance efficiency. Highlight '40%' and 'waste' in solar orange.

Analytical spread with 2-column structure. Headers: 'Technology readiness' / 'Market deployment'. Image top-half showing next-gen solar panel manufacturing. Below: analysis of lab-to-market timelines vs commercial scaling challenges. Solar orange column headers.

Stats card with solid electric blue background showing 3 horizontal stats: '$2.8T climate tech market size', '67% cost reduction in clean energy', '15M new jobs created'. Stats layout with orientation horizontal. White text on blue background.
